long_biography.plain_text:
A native of Tripoli, Taha Azmi Mikati studied engineering at the American University of Beirut and started his career in Abu Dhabi. Shortly after graduation he established Arabian Construction Company, which grew into a major regional contractor. Returning to Lebanon in the late 1970s, he adapted maritime satellite technology to restore communications from his office during the civil war.

Demand for those satellite links led Mikati and his younger brother to establish Investcom in 1982. The company expanded mobile networks across the Middle East and Africa, listed in London and Dubai, and was later combined with MTN. Mikati subsequently became chairman of M1 Group, the family investment holding company; day-to-day executive leadership now rests with his son Azmi.
